selected_records.title: Pentagon CIO gets new strategic technical advisor

article.body:
Pentagon CIO gets strategic technical advisor; no UAS details established

The available record says the Pentagon CIO has a new strategic technical advisor but does not identify the advisor or describe any drone, UAS or other uncrewed-systems capability. It provides no evidence of autonomy, sensors, payloads, testing, production or deployment. No capability demonstration or operational status can be established from the record.
